construction.implementation_origin: Original standalone implementation created for this build

shared_schema.input: synthetic=true, question, sources[{id,text,optional emissions}], products[{id,name,description,tags,asset_kinds,priorities}], meter_csv, telemetry{assets,samples}, outages, feedback
shared_schema.envelope: schema_version, stage, data{synthetic,question,sources,products,assets,samples,meter_readings,outages,feedback}, results{research,search,documents,insights}; results accumulate in order
shared_schema.output: status=ok plus final envelope; errors: status=error,message with process exit 2
shared_schema.meter_interval_csv: Exact headers timestamp,meter_id,asset_id,kwh. Nonnegative kWh; timezone-aware interval start; duplicate meter/time instants rejected. Synthetic example uses half-hour winter intervals and a summer comparison interval.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validation layer used at every stage input and output; source citations, product compatibility, recommendation lineage, meter totals, telemetry provenance, CSV and insight lineage checked

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated query expanded from ranked exact source excerpts and stable citation IDs
Validated ranked products with evidence IDs and compatible outage IDs determine per-outage recommendations
Validated outage rows determine feedback theme priority and recommended product associations

behavior.research: General-purpose deterministic lexical evidence ranking with quoted excerpts, citations and explicit insufficient-evidence status; no invented factual answer
behavior.search: General-purpose token matching with fixed synonym groups, deterministic ranking and energy asset-kind/safety capability filters
behavior.documents: Parse interval CSV and telemetry JSON, aggregate consumption, preserve emissions provenance, generate formula-safe outage CSV and structured rows
behavior.insights: Multi-label keyword themes, sentiment counts, feedback evidence IDs, document-linked products and safety-prioritized actions
behavior.protection: NERC CIP-style demonstrative minimization: all grid asset and meter IDs replaced by deterministic per-input aliases, including free-text occurrences, before stage processing. No reverse mapping emitted. Errors never echo rejected payloads or paths.
behavior.safety_rules: P1 for life_safety; otherwise P2 for critical_service or customers_affected >=100; otherwise P3. Conflicting declared priorities rejected. Feedback cannot override outage priorities.
behavior.emissions_rules: Every emissions figure requires finite nonnegative value, supported unit kgCO2e or tCO2e, and nonblank source. Figures are preserved, not mixed or converted.
behavior.empty_cases: Empty sources, products, readings, samples, outages and feedback supported; topology and question required
behavior.determinism: Stable sorting; no random values, clocks, network access, providers or injected model steps

limitations: Aliasing is demonstrative minimization, not encryption or a security boundary; source input still contains fictitious identifiers.
Product priorities are fixture declarations, not independently certified capabilities.
Theme counts can overlap; sentiment uses a bounded keyword lexicon.
Meter totals cover supplied intervals, not an inferred continuous season.

test_outcomes.cli: passed: example input printed one JSON object with status ok and exit 0
test_outcomes.error_cli: Validated exit 2 and JSON status error for missing file, malformed JSON, invalid schema and usage
